title: Unveiling The Femme Within
description: Step into a transformative journey where your truest desires come to light. Unveiling the Femme Within is a deeply immersive immersion session designed to guide you into a beautiful realm of self-discovery and feminine empowerment. As you follow the voice of Goddess Amethyst, you will enter a magical room filled with mirrors, each reflecting a unique version of your inner self - poised, confident, and radiant in every aspect of life. This session allows you to emotionally connect with these reflections, from the ambitious career woman to the enchanting beauty on a night out. You’ll feel the energy, confidence, and beauty of each version of yourself as you explore how your inner femme wishes to express herself in the world. Goddess Amethyst uses her commanding voice to guide you through a  sequence of commands, embedding powerful suggestions into you to strengthen your connection with your feminine energy.
